name: huashu-slide-doubao
title_zh: 用豆包自带生图出整套 PPT，一分第三方 API 钱
tagline_zh: 做课件、公众号头图、B站封面都得掏生图 API 的钱。它把这步锁死在豆包内置 seedream 上，还给封面、扉页、内容页、结论页各配一条密度上限。
tagline_en: Course decks, WeChat headers and Bilibili thumbnails all bill you per generated image. This one pins that step to Doubao's built-in seedream, and gives covers, section breaks, content pages and closers four separate density ceilings.
desc_en: 豆包环境专用的视觉物料生产：PPT / Keynote / HTML deck、公众号封面与正文配图、B站/YouTube 视频封面。存在的全部理由是走豆包内置 image_gen（默认 seedream_5.0_pro 模型），不花第三方图像 API 的钱——不在豆包环境就别用。用户说做PPT、幻灯片、演示文稿、deck、公众号封面、视频封面时触发。
why_zh: 它给字数上限配了反向约束：正文明写「AI 看到 220 字上限就会朝 220 字写」，于是先逼你答这页要人记住哪一句。
why_en: The word ceiling comes with a counterweight: the text warns that a model told "220 characters max" will write to 220, so every page must first name the one line the audience should remember.
limit_zh: 不在豆包环境就别装——作者写明它「存在的全部理由」就是豆包自带的 image_gen，默认的 seedream_5.0_pro 还是会员专属，非会员回退 4.5。产物默认是图片式 PPT，文字不可编辑，除非你明说要可编辑、或生图连挂三次。
limit_en: Don't install this outside Doubao — the author calls the built-in image_gen its entire reason to exist, and the default seedream_5.0_pro is members-only, falling back to 4.5 for everyone else. Slides come out as flat images with no editable text unless you explicitly ask for editable output, or generation fails three times.
title_en: Full decks via Doubao's built-in image gen, zero.
